name: manual_a88a10
claim: SSRF validation must convert IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses before checking is_link_local: if isinstance(addr, ipaddress.IPv6Address) and addr.ipv4_mapped is not None: addr = addr.ipv4_mapped. Without this, ::ffff:169.254.x.x passes ipv6.is_link_local=False check even though the underlying IPv4 address is link-local. Fixed in PT PR #154 alphaclaw_bootstrap.py.

decisions.notes: Security gap surfaced during PR #154 security hardening; IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass was a real SSRF vector

rationale: Security gap surfaced during PR #154 security hardening; IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass was a real SSRF vector
